explication: Freeplane is a Java desktop mind-mapping application for creating and navigating mapped information. The principal workflow is to edit a map’s node structure, navigate or filter it, and use product features such as links and export to share or inspect information. The tree also shows substantial extensions for scripting, formulas, code exploration, AI, Markdown, LaTeX, and geographic maps. The supplied excerpts support only a few internal calls; other capability relationships are documented at a high level in the README, so those links are not inferred.
